yaml.subtitle: General objectives, work packages and activities

markdown.markdown:
The project is organised into five work packages (WP), each aligned with a General Objective (GO). Each WP sets out Specific Objectives (SO) and Activities (A). A cross-cutting activity covers this website: - **A1.** Update the project's interactive website to disseminate results, share data and code, and support reproducibility. ::: {.wp-card} ### GO1. Identify, predict and correct the bias of Theil index estimators

Researchers: E. Álvarez, R. Cano, R.M. García, P.J. Moya, A.J. López, J.F. Muñoz

- **SO1.** Quantify the bias of the estimators and the data features that cause it, comparing the sensitivity of $T_0$ and $T_1$. - A2. Design the Monte Carlo experiment. - A3. Relative bias (RB) and bias ratio (BR) of $T_0$ and $T_1$ (H1, H2). - **SO2.** Predict the bias from observable sample features, as a diagnostic tool. - A4. GAM models for the bias. - A5. Qualitative bias scale: negligible, mild, moderate, severe (H3). - **SO3.** New bias-correction techniques and their impact on the MSE. - A6. Jackknife and GAM-based corrected estimators. - A7. Comparison with analytical and semiparametric corrections (H4, H5). - **SO4.** Bias in the between- and within-group decomposition. - A8. Bias of the decomposition components (H6). ::: ## WP2 · Reliable inference ::: {.wp-card} ### GO2. Reliable inference for Theil indices under strong skewness and inequality

Researchers: E. Álvarez, J. Chica, R.M. García, P.J. Moya, J.F. Muñoz, F. Vendrell

- **SO5.** Bias of variance estimators and coverage of confidence intervals. - A9. Evaluation of asymptotic, bootstrap, semiparametric and jackknife variances. - A10. Scenarios where inference becomes unreliable (H7). - **SO6.** New variance estimators and confidence intervals. - A11. Jackknife variances and new confidence intervals. - A12. Comparison and recommendations (H8). ::: ## WP3 · Computationally efficient inference ::: {.wp-card} ### GO3. Reduce the computational cost of the jackknife

Researchers: E. Álvarez, J. Chica, I. García, A.J. López, P.J. Moya, J.F. Muñoz

- **SO7.** Computational cost of the standard jackknife compared with alternative methods. - A13. Execution times (H9). - **SO8.** Efficient jackknife expressions with no loss of accuracy. - A14. Analytical jackknife expressions. - A15. Implementation and validation (H10). ::: ## WP4 · The R package theil ::: {.wp-card} ### GO4. Open, efficient and reproducible software

Researchers: E. Álvarez, J. Chica, A.J. López, P.J. Moya, J.F. Muñoz

- **SO9.** R package **theil**, with a C++ core (Rcpp). - A16. Development of the package. - A17. Documentation with vignettes and release on CRAN. ::: ## WP5 · Multidisciplinary transfer ::: {.wp-card} ### GO5. Transfer to the Social Sciences

Researchers: all team members (coordinated by both PIs)

- **SO10.** Water: inequality in household water consumption and expenditure between and within municipalities. - A18 (H13). - **SO11.** Tourism: effect of tourism on income inequality within and between destinations. - A19 (H14). - **SO12.** Firms: servitization, digital transformation and AI adoption. - A20 (H15). - **SO13.** Global convergence in per capita consumption with bias-corrected estimators. - A21 (H16). :::
